A basketball player averages $25$ points per game. The points occur at a constant rate, randomly in time, and independently of one another. Using the normal approximation to the Poisson distribution, approximate the probability that the player scores exactly $20$ points in a game. Give your final answer to three decimal places.

*Hint: The data below is taken from the table of values of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z)$ for the standard normal distribution.*

| $z$ | $0.00$ | $0.01$ | $0.02$ |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |

| $-1.0$ | $0.1587$ | $0.1562$ | $0.1539$ |
| $-0.9$ | $0.1841$ | $0.1814$ | $0.1788$ |
